The left bay measures exactly 5.80m in the drawing, a clean round number, while the right bay works out to 3.485m as the remainder after subtracting all other dimensions from 10.00m. This confirms the design intent: "5.86" is likely a typo for "5.80" and "4.00" is significantly off from the actual 3.49m.

Either way, both labels contradict the drawing and the chain fails to close by 0.575m, so I'll flag both discrepancies. Checking the rest of the title block — date 27.07.2026, plan A-01, scale 1:100 — everything else verifies correctly, and "GRUNDRISS EG" (ground floor plan) is consistent with the entrance door placement on the outer wall.

I notice the vertical dimension has no internal sub-chain breaking down the SCHLAFEN/BAD split (4.085/0.115/2.20), which is worth noting as a completeness gap rather than an outright error. Doing a final sweep for hidden layers or additional annotations, I've now checked ten labels total.

Tallying up all the dimension values, room names, areas, title block fields, door widths, and wall thicknesses, I land on roughly 24-27 items verified. I confirm the entrance door opening (1.00m wide) matches the wall band correctly with only slight overdraw, so I'm confident in the results and ready to write up the final findings: the "5.86" dimension for the left bay doesn't match the drawn 5.80m, and the "4.00" dimension for the right bay doesn't match the drawn 3.485m.

The dimension chain doesn't actually sum correctly — 0.30+5.86+0.115+4.00+0.30 equals 10.575, not the labeled 10.00m total — and I'll report this as its own distinct finding since it's independently checkable, even though it stems from the same root issues. I also note the room areas are mislabeled: WOHNEN should be 37.12 m² not 31.2, SCHLAFEN should be 14.24 m² not 13.4, and BAD should be 7.67 m² not 6.9. Additionally, BAD is only accessible through SCHLAFEN with no direct door from WOHNEN.

I'm deciding to include both the accessibility issue and the missing vertical dimension chain for the SCHLAFEN/BAD split as separate findings, since the task calls for reporting every error found — one is a genuine planning defect, the other an omission that leaves the contractor without needed information. findings.explanation: Only the overall 7.00 m is dimensioned vertically. The SCHLAFEN / BAD split (4.085 m + 0.115 m partition + 2.200 m clear, inside 0.30 m walls) is undimensioned, so the contractor cannot set out the horizontal partition from this sheet. Add the chain 30 / 4.085 / 11.5 / 2.20 / 30.

structured_output.summary: The drawn geometry is internally consistent — the shell is exactly 10.00 x 7.00 m, walls 30 cm, partitions 11.5 cm, and the drawn bays (5.800 + 3.485 m) close perfectly against the overall — but five printed values contradict it. The width chain 30/5.86/11.5/4.00/30 sums to 10.575 m instead of 10.00 m: 5.86 should read 5.80 and 4.00 should read 3.49. All three room areas are understated as well (WOHNEN 31.2 vs 37.12 m2, SCHLAFEN 13.4 vs 14.24 m2, BAD 6.9 vs 7.67 m2), and their total of 51.5 m2 is impossible inside a 70 m2 footprint with these wall thicknesses. Two further items to resolve before issue: BAD is only reachable through SCHLAFEN, and the vertical direction has no sub-dimension chain, so the horizontal partition cannot be set out.
